english.title: Cause/permit destruction/disposal/falsification/concealment of information required by CMA/other re digital markets
english.standardoffencewording:

(A)_[the Competition and Markets Authority]_
(B)_[**(..SPECIFY OTHER PERSON..)]_

english.notes:
(i) The destruction, disposal, falsification or concealment of such information is an offence under section 93(1)(a) of the Digital Markets, Competition and Consumers Act 2024, see H101708.
(ii) For offences by body corporates see section 96.
(iii) Extra-territorial jurisdiction: for restriction of this offence in relation to acts done by a person who is outside the United Kingdom, see sections 93(2) and 97 of the Act.
(iv) The CMA may not impose a penalty on a person under section 87 in relation to an act or omission which constitutes this offence, if the person has, in relation to that act or omission, been found guilty of that offence, and a person may not be found guilty of this offence by virtue of an act or omission which constitutes this offence, see sections 87 and 92.
(v) A statement by a person in response to a requirement imposed by virtue of section 72 (a "section 72 statement" may be used in evidence against that person on a prosecution for this offence, for details see section 73.
